title: Disabling NOC via the settings row while the panel is open leaves the panel stuck ON with no way to dismiss it
detail: Spec scope 1 gates the surface at runtime via 'a settings flag', and scope 5 makes that flag the removal knob ('the toggle default + the settings flag make future removal a one-line change'). But the row flips only noc_enabled: with the panel open (overlay_on=true), drawing continues (gate checks overlay_on only) and D becomes a no-op — the panel is stuck visible all session, contradicting the PR body's 'zero pixels in every frame' removal claim.
recommended_fix: In the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case, clear the panel when disabling: `app.noc_enabled = !app.noc_enabled; if !app.noc_enabled { app.overlay_on = false }` (or gate the draw on `app.overlay_on && app.noc_enabled`); extend noc_toggle_test to pin it.
